description: Pentatonix, the a cappella vocal group, play their Christmas in the City tour at the Kia Forum in Inglewood (7pm).
Touring production of Disney's The Lion King at the Hollywood Pantages Theatre (7:30pm).
New Wave Nite, a free 9pm-1am night of new wave, 80s, 90s and EDM with DJ Alpha at Heat Ultra Lounge in Anaheim.
Free karaoke brunch hosted by WeLoveKaraoke at Gritz N Wafflez (6pm), listed via Posh.
Los Angeles Ballet's production of The Nutcracker at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood (7:30pm).
A Christmas Carol staged by A Noise Within, the theater company in Pasadena (7pm).
